ImageDescription.value: Taken from the observation platform at the top of the Jantar Mantar, showing smaller architectural sundials. The Jantar Mantar is a collection of architectural astronomical instruments, built by Maharaja Jai Singh II at his then new capital of Jaipur between 1727 and 1733. The City Palace behind then Govindji Temple. Nahargarh Fort on Hill.
